about.label: The Culture of Movement
about.description: Hip-hop dance has been at the heart of internet culture since the beginning. AI-generated hip-hop dance videos combine the energy of street dance with the surprise of unexpected subjects.

items.title: High Energy Content
items.description: Hip-hop moves are dynamic and attention-grabbing. The fast, rhythmic movements keep viewers watching and rewatching, which algorithms love.

items.question: What hip-hop dance styles are available?
items.answer: We offer several hip-hop dance templates including smooth groove, energetic choreography, and street dance moves. New hip-hop templates are added regularly based on trending styles.

items.question: Can I use any photo for hip-hop dance?
items.answer: Yes! Any clear, front-facing photo works. The most entertaining results come from unexpected subjects — babies, pets, historical figures, or formal portraits doing hip-hop moves.

items.question: Are the dance moves realistic?
items.answer: Our AI uses motion-control technology to generate smooth, natural-looking dance movements. The hip-hop templates are designed to capture the energy and rhythm of real street dance.

items.question: What music is included?
items.answer: Each template comes with pre-synced audio that matches the dance style. The hip-hop templates feature urban beats and rhythms that complement the moves.

items.question: Can I use these for music videos?
items.answer: Yes. The generated videos are yours to use for any purpose, including music video content, social media, and commercial projects.
